Pork Xiaolongbao.note: Wheat skin; light soy sauce = soy + gluten; Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten, not halal; pork and pork aspic. Chinkiang vinegar dip (wheat bran) = gluten. Ginger is not spicy.

Crab Roe Xiaolongbao.note: As Pork Xiaolongbao plus hairy crab roe = crustaceans.

Truffle Xiaolongbao.note: Wheat skin, light soy sauce, pork. No wine named. Sold out.

Chicken Xiaolongbao.note: Wheat skin, light soy sauce, Chinkiang vinegar dip. Chicken aspic stated no pork, no wine: halal by ingredients at a halal 'none' branch (v8 ruling 1).

Pan-fried Shengjian Bao.note: Wheat yeast dough, soy sauce, sesame seeds; pork.

Wontons in Chilli Oil.note: Egg-dough wheat wrappers; prawn = crustaceans; chilli oil with sesame; soy sauce; Chinkiang vinegar; pork. Described spicy.

Vegetable & Mushroom Dumplings.note: Wheat skin, tofu = soy, sesame oil. Mung bean glass noodles have no gluten. Stated no onion or garlic. Shiitake is not a mollusc.

Drunken Chicken.note: Shaoxing wine = sulphites + gluten, not halal. Goji berries no allergen. Not spicy.

Smacked Cucumber.note: Chinkiang black vinegar (wheat bran) = gluten (v7); sesame oil. 'A little chilli oil, mildly spicy' = 1. Garlic (allium).

Scallion Pancake.note: Wheat flour, vegetable oil (no lard), spring onion (allium).

Shanghai Smoked Fish.note: Fish; dark soy = soy + gluten; Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten, not halal.

Dan Dan Noodles.note: Wheat noodles (no egg stated); sesame paste; roasted peanuts; soy sauce; pork. Ya cai is preserved mustard greens, not the mustard allergen (rule m). Spicy.

Shanghai Fried Noodles.note: Wheat noodles; dark soy = soy + gluten; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (g); pork. Default protein pork.

Egg Fried Rice.note: Egg only; white pepper not spicy. Add-ons (prawns, chicken, pork floss) are not counted; crab meat is the add-on that is out.

Braised Pork Belly.note: Pork; Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten; soy sauce.

Hot and Sour Soup.note: Tofu = soy; egg ribbons; Chinkiang vinegar = gluten; shredded pork. Mildly spicy = 1.

Stir-fried Bok Choy.note: Bok choy, garlic, salt, vegetable oil. No oyster sauce.

Dumpling Set for Two.note: Union of its default parts: Pork Xiaolongbao, Shengjian Bao, Wontons in Chilli Oil (spicy, prawn, egg), Smacked Cucumber, Chinese Tea.

Spicy Beef Noodle Soup.note: Wheat noodles; doubanjiang = soy + gluten; chilli oil with sesame. Beef, no pork or alcohol: halal by ingredients at a 'none' branch. Spicy. Late night only.

Pork Wonton Soup.note: Egg-dough wheat wrappers; shrimp and dried shrimp = crustaceans; pork bone broth. Late night only.

Century Egg Congee.note: Century egg (duck egg); pork; rice congee has no gluten. Late night only.

Red Bean Pancake.note: Wheat flour and egg crepe; red bean paste. No lard stated.

Black Sesame Tang Yuan.note: Glutinous rice (no gluten); black sesame; pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. Ginger syrup not spicy.

Sour Plum Drink.note: Smoked plum, hawthorn, osmanthus, rock sugar.

Tsingtao Beer.note: Barley malt = gluten; alcohol, not halal; vegan as v7/v8 lagers.
